column2: Arrange the vegetables in a baking dish and drizzle with oil and thyme.
Top with crumbled cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Pumpkin soup with ginger
1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
Add the chopped pumpkin, carrot, ginger and water.
Cook for 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Banana oat cookies with walnuts
1.5 cups rolled oats
Mash the bananas and mix with the oats, walnuts and cinnamon.
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto a tray.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until the cookies hold together, then let cool.
Baked turkey köfte with carrot and zucchini
350 g minced turkey
Knead the minced turkey, vegetables, egg and breadcrumbs and shape small köfte.
Bake on a tray lined with baking paper for about 25 minutes until fully cooked inside.
Bulgur soup with roasted tomatoes
Half a tea glass fine bulgur
Roast the tomatoes in the oven at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Add the peeled tomatoes, bulgur and water.
Cook for 15 minutes until the bulgur is soft and serve.
Baked garlic broccoli and potatoes
Slice the potatoes thinly and separate the broccoli into florets.
Toss the vegetables with crushed garlic, oil and thyme.
Bake for 30 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Rice pilaf with chicken and zucchini
Wash the rice and soak in lukewarm water for 15 minutes.
Cook the diced chicken through in a pan.
Add the grated zucchini and rice and toast briefly.
Add the hot water, cook over low heat until absorbed and let rest for 10 minutes.
Red cabbage yogurt meze
Half a small red cabbage
Finely shred the cabbage and rub with lemon.
Soften in olive oil for 5 minutes and let cool.
Combine the cooled cabbage with the yogurt and serve.
Chard with chickpeas and tomato
Wash the chard in plenty of water and chop together with the stems.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the tomato.
Put the chard and chickpeas in the pot.
Add half a tea glass of water and cook for 15 minutes until the chard is soft.
Baked lemon chicken wings
600 g chicken wings
Mix the lemon, oil, garlic and thyme.
Coat the wings well with the sauce and arrange on a tray.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, turning occasionally, until fully cooked inside.
Baked polenta with mushrooms and cheese
1 cup corn grits (polenta)
Slowly pour the corn grits into boiling water and thicken, stirring constantly.
Slice the mushrooms and sauté in butter until the liquid evaporates.
Spread the polenta in a baking dish and add the mushrooms and grated cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 15 minutes until the cheese melts and browns.
Beetroot salad with orange
A handful of rocket
Let the beetroots cool and slice thinly.
Peel the orange and separate the segments from the membranes.
Toss all the ingredients with walnuts and olive oil.
Baked pasta with spinach and lor
200 g spinach
Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the packet time.
Mix the pasta, spinach and lor and transfer to a baking dish.
Whisk the milk and eggs and pour over; bake for 20 minutes.
Zucchini and lentil mücver
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the excess liquid.
Lightly mash the lentils with a fork.
Mix with the egg, flour and chopped dill.
Place small portions on baking paper and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.
Baked apple cinnamon cake
Preheat the oven to 175°C.
Beat the eggs and sugar and add the milk.
Fold the flour, baking powder and cinnamon into the mixture.
Add the diced apples and pour into the tin.
Bake for about 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Wheat salad with mint and yogurt
1.5 cups cooked whole wheat
Let the cooked wheat cool completely.
Dice the cucumber small and chop the mint.
Mix the yogurt with olive oil.
Combine all the ingredients and serve cold.
Baked bean köfte with tomato
Mash the beans and knead with the grated onion, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape small köfte and arrange on a tray.
Spoon grated tomato over them and bake for 25 minutes.
Cauliflower salad with lemon and dill
Separate the cauliflower into florets and steam so it stays slightly firm.
Leave to cool completely.
Finely chop the onion and the dill.
Toss with lemon and oil and serve.
Baked turkey and mushroom sauté
350 g turkey breast
Cut the turkey into small pieces.
Slice the mushrooms, pepper and onion.
Toss all the ingredients with oil and spread in a wide baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the turkey is fully cooked.
Baked banana oat bars
2 cups rolled oats
2 tablespoons raisins
Mash the bananas and mix with the peanut butter.
Add the oats, raisins and cinnamon.
Press the mixture into a small tin.
Bake for 20-25 minutes and slice once completely cool.
Bulgur kısır with roasted peppers
2 roasted kapia peppers
Chop the roasted peppers and spring onion small.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork and add the vegetables.
Potato and leek omelette
1 small leek
Cut the potato into small cubes and cook in a pan until soft.
Add the finely chopped leek and sauté for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and milk and pour into the pan.
Cook both sides over low heat until the eggs are fully cooked.
Cinnamon pear semolina pudding
1 pear
Heat the milk, semolina and sugar in a pot while whisking.
Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Peel and dice the pear and mix with cinnamon.
Divide the semolina pudding into bowls and top with the pear.
Baked zucchini slices with yogurt
Preheat the oven to 190°C and slice the zucchini into rounds.
Whisk the yogurt, egg, oil and mint.
Toss the zucchini with the sauce and arrange in a single row on the tray.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden on top and the zucchini are soft.
Tomato soup with red lentils
Wash the lentils; chop the onion and sauté in oil.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Baked chicken thighs with thyme
4 chicken thighs
Cut the potatoes into large slices and put on a tray with the thighs.
Toss with oil, thyme and crushed garlic.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked with no pink inside.
Sautéed chard with chickpeas
1 dessert spoon tomato paste
Wash the chard in plenty of water and chop.
Soften the onion in oil and fry the tomato paste.
Add the chickpeas and chard and stir.
Cook covered for 12-15 minutes until the chard is soft.
Lemon carrot couscous
Grate the carrot and sauté in oil for 3 minutes.
Add the couscous and stir for 1 minute.
Add the hot water and cook until absorbed.
Stir in the lemon juice and let rest for 5 minutes.
Baked eggplant rolls with lor
Slice the eggplants into long thin strips and brush with oil.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until soft.
Mix the lor with chopped parsley and roll up in the slices.
Top with grated tomato and bake for another 15 minutes.
Oat bowl with apple and tahini
5 tablespoons oats
1 dessert spoon tahini
Cook the oats and milk in a small pan for 5-6 minutes.
Grate the apple and mix with cinnamon.
Transfer the cooked oats to a bowl.
Top with the apple and tahini and serve.
Roasted eggplant yogurt meze with tahini
Roast the eggplants on the hob or in the oven and let cool.
Peel and finely chop the flesh.
Mix with the yogurt, crushed garlic and lemon.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
Bulgur with mushrooms and spinach
150 g mushrooms
2 handfuls spinach
Sauté the onion and sliced mushrooms in oil.
